description:
Learn how to use Genspark Claw step by step and see what AI computer automation can actually do in a real workflow. In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to organize files automatically, analyze spreadsheets, generate reports, schedule recurring tasks, summarize meetings, and more using Genspark Claw.

Genspark is an all-in-one AI workspace that combines tools like AI chat, spreadsheets, slide creation, design, and automation into a single platform. Instead of switching between multiple tools, you can use Genspark AI to complete your entire workflow in one place.

We’ll also look at how to:
- Run AI tasks directly on your PC or in the cloud
- Organize messy files automatically
- Analyze Excel data and generate charts
- Create recurring AI workflows and schedules
- Generate meeting notes and summaries
- Connect AI with Gmail, Google Calendar, Teams, Slack, and more
- Use multiple AI models including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Grok

Paid users get unlimited usage of AI image and AI chat.
